successCriteria.description: The `AuditLog` entity interface is defined in `src/modules/audit/audit.model.ts` with exactly these 11 fields and types: `id: string`, `entityType: string`, `entityId: string`, `action: string`, `oldValues: Record<string, any> | null`, `newValues: Record<string, any> | null`, `performedBy: string | null`, `performedAt: Date`, `ipAddress: string | null`, `userAgent: string | null`, `createdAt: Date`.

The `IAuditLogRepository` interface is defined in `src/modules/audit/audit.repository.ts` with exactly these four methods: `findById(id: string): Promise<AuditLog | null>`, `findByEntity(entityType: string, entityId: string): Promise<AuditLog[]>`, `findByPerformedBy(performedBy: string): Promise<AuditLog[]>`, `create(log: Omit<AuditLog, 'id' | 'createdAt'>): Promise<AuditLog>`.
A stub `AuditLogRepository` class implements `IAuditLogRepository`; every method uses underscore-prefixed unused parameters and throws `new Error('not implemented')`.
A barrel export `src/modules/audit/index.ts` re-exports `AuditLog` from `audit.model.ts` and `IAuditLogRepository`, `AuditLogRepository` from `audit.repository.ts`.

Unit test `tests/unit/modules/audit/audit.model.test.ts` validates: a valid AuditLog object shape with all 11 fields, nullable fields accept null, `oldValues`/`newValues` accept `Record<string, any>` objects, exact field names and count (11), and `performedAt`/`createdAt` are `Date` instances.

Unit test `tests/unit/modules/audit/audit.repository.test.ts` validates: every stub method throws `'not implemented'`, `create` accepts `Omit<AuditLog, 'id' | 'createdAt'>` input, and the interface contract check confirms all four methods are functions on the stub instance.

constraints: The audit module depends only on `src/shared/types/index.ts` (Phase 1). It must not import from any other module (employee, leave-policy, leave-balance, leave-request, notification).
The `AuditLog` entity is immutable — once created, its fields must never be mutated. There is no `update` or `delete` method on the repository interface.
The `action` field is typed as `string` (not the `AuditAction` enum) to accommodate any action string from any domain, not just leave-request actions.
outOfScope: AuditService interface and implementation — deferred to Phase 10 (supporting services).
DB-backed repository implementation (real PostgreSQL queries via Knex) — deferred to a later phase.

entityInvariants.invariant: Every AuditLog record is immutable — it has no update or delete lifecycle. Once created, its fields are permanent. The repository exposes only `create` and read methods; there is no mutation path.

Every AuditLog record must reference a valid domain entity via the composite `(entityType, entityId)` pair. The `entityType` is a string identifying the domain aggregate (e.g. 'LeaveRequest', 'LeaveBalance', 'LeavePolicy'), and `entityId` is the primary key of that entity. Referential integrity is enforced at the service/DB layer in later phases.

`oldValues` and `newValues` are independently nullable. When `action` is `CREATE`, `oldValues` must be `null` and `newValues` must be non-null. When `action` is `DELETE`, `oldValues` must be non-null and `newValues` must be `null`. When `action` is `UPDATE`, both must be non-null. This invariant is enforced at the service layer in a later phase.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository layer — auth is enforced at the service/controller layer in later phases.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns the created `AuditLog` with `id` and `createdAt` populated. The stub throws `'not implemented'`.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns an array (empty if no matching logs). The stub throws `'not implemented'`.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `AuditLog` model file must follow the same JSDoc + interface export pattern as `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` and `src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts`: a JSDoc block describing the entity's purpose and invariants, followed by the exported interface.

The `AuditLogRepository` stub class must follow the same pattern as `EmployeeRepository` and `NotificationRepository`: each method uses underscore-prefixed unused parameters, throws `new Error('not implemented')`, and the class explicitly `implements IAuditLogRepository`.

The barrel export `src/modules/audit/index.ts` must follow the same re-export pattern as `src/modules/employee/index.ts` and `src/modules/notification/index.ts`: re-export the model interface and the repository interface + stub class.

The model test must import `AuditLog` from the barrel `../../../../src/modules/audit` (not from the model file directly), matching the import pattern in `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.model.test.ts`.

The repository test must import `AuditLogRepository`, `IAuditLogRepository`, and `AuditLog` from the barrel `../../../../src/modules/audit`, matching the import pattern in `tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.repository.test.ts`.

integrationPoints.why: The audit module is the sole dependency of this phase. The `AuditLog` entity does not reference any shared enum directly (action is a free-form string), but the module must be able to import shared types if needed in later phases.
